en: Alright...it's right here.

<CLT=cltMIND>Just when I reached my hand
toward the door...
Oh, wait! I'm pretty sure that door is locked!
<CLT=cltMIND>Locked?

Ah, that's right. Angie did say that she
locks the room when she's working.

<CLT=cltMIND>I grabbed the doorknob anyway,
just to test it.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
So it is locked.
Move.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki pushed me aside and began
pounding on the door.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*bam! bam! bam!*
Angie, open this door. Now.

W-Wait, Maki! You can't do it like that!
Stop being li'l ol' Miss Impatient!
Then how should I do it?

Angie will only open the door when a student
council member calls for her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko turned back to the door and
gave it a few nervous knocks.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*knock, knock, knock*

Angie, it's Tenko. I wanna talk to you about
something... Can you open the door?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
...Oh, Tenko?
Yeah, it's me!

<CLT=cltMIND>After Tenko answered, the door
flew open.
Yah-hah! Can I help you?
...Huh? Why are Shuichi and Maki here?
Ah, um—

Oh, I get it. You both wanna join the student
council, huh?

Then you'll need to get acquainted with Atua.
I will introduce you to Him.
Please, come in.
Ah, no, it's not that...
Let's go in for now. We can talk inside.
Well...I suppose.

<CLT=cltMIND>Invited by Angie, we stepped
into her lab.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...

<CLT=cltMIND>We weren't prepared for what
we were about to see.
Oh, Shuichi! Not that way!
What? Isn't Angie in here?

Yeah, but we should go in through the front
door.
Huh? Why?
I'm gonna challenge Angie to make her stop!

So I need to face her head-on from the
front door, fair and square!
I really don't think it matters.
W-Well, if it'll make Tenko feel better...
...Fine. Do whatever you want.
<CLT=cltMIND>Let's go to the other door.

<CLT=cltMIND>What is this...? It's like a hanging
scroll, but it's blank.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.
